description: This file contains functions related to Content Security Policy (CSP) management, specifically computing hashes for inline scripts in HTML and building CSP headers with those hashes.

methods.name: computeInlineScriptHashes
methods.description: Computes SHA-256 hashes for inline, script tags in an HTML string that lack a 'src' attribute.

methods.name: buildControlUiCspHeader
methods.description: Generates a Content Security Policy (CSP) header string, optionally including inline script hashes.
